text:
release-bot: canary rollout started for inference-gateway r2026-03-15-42 -> canary group (5%)
incident-bot: ALERT created INC-2026-0315-1 — 502 spikes on /v1/generate for canary instances (threshold crossed)
incident-bot: paging maya (SRE oncall) via PagerDuty
maya: ack, I'm looking. grabbing logs + tailing canary pods
arjun: saw the spike too, looks like 502 + repeated KMS errors in logs. low latency but 502 responses from modelproxy
julia: can confirm: errors start ~02:04 UTC, ~45s after canary started. error rate 12% at peak
samir: any recent config changes? release notes mention rotated customer KMS key and new env var KEY_ID set in the deployment
maya: pulling pod logs... snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:04:12Z ERROR modelproxy: decrypt failed: RpcError: PermissionDenied; failed to decrypt with key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/key-rot-2026
CausedBy: iam.credentials.AccessDenied: User "serviceAccount:gateway@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" does not have permissions to CryptoKeyVersions: 'decrypt'
```
arjun: that matches. Can confirm new env var KMS_KEY_ID was added in the canary manifest: `KMS_KEY_ID=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/key-rot-2026`
julia: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback canary to prior revision 2) flip feature flag to bypass KMS path 3) patch SA perms (risky during active deploy)
maya: prioritize rollback + flag kill-switch. we need to stop customer impact now.
samir: agreed. initiating rollback.
release-bot: rollback requested by maya: triggering `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway`
release-bot: rollback started -> observability will report new metrics in ~30s
ops-oncall: I'll flip the feature flag for the route as backup: running `ldctl toggle --key inference-kms-v2 --off --env prod`
incident-bot: action recorded: rollback + flag-off.
maya: watching metrics... error rate dropping. at 02:06 UTC errors down to 0.8%
arjun: noting impacted window: 02:04:10 — 02:06:05 UTC, ~115s. traffic directed to canary group only but ramped to 5% so roughly 5% of requests in that window affected.
julia: customer impact: 14 external API requests got 502s from a single high-volume enterprise tenant (tenant-id: t-8472). outreach queued to success team.
samir: root cause summary (initial): rotated KMS key id deployed to canary without corresponding IAM binding for the service account used by inference-gateway. decrypt calls fail, resulting in 502s when modelproxy fails to load encrypted artifacts or decrypt tokens.
maya: creating incident ticket INC-2026-0315-1 with status: mitigated (rollback + flag). will handoff to arjun for postmortem and perms fix
arjun: ACK. I'll own follow-ups: 1) add pre-deploy KMS perm-check to release pipeline (automated IAM dry-run) 2) verify key rotation playbook to update SA bindings before env var rollout 3) add guard in deployment stage to run smoke decrypt check against KMS key ID
julia: also recommend: add a release gate that fails if pod logs contain 'decrypt failed' during canary window
ops-oncall: leaving a note for next oncall: if rotation needs rollback, do not reapply rotated key to prod until SA binding confirmed. I'll also open a support ticket with KMS team to audit binding creation logs.
maya: handing off to ops-oncall for warm handover then to arjun for root cause. I'll remain available
ops-oncall: taking over for monitoring and comms. updating status page: "Partial errors for inference-gateway during canary, mitigated. Under investigation."
incident-bot: incident updated: status -> acknowledged -> mitigated; responders: maya, arjun, julia, samir
arjun: plan of record: patch infra: add terraform step to create IAM binding `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for service account before key is set in env; add automated smoke decrypt in CI; run full canary again tomorrow after fix; schedule postmortem doc (link will be created)
maya: will collect timelines and logs and add to postmortem. please include command snippets used during mitigation in postmortem: 
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway
ldctl toggle --key inference-kms-v2 --off --env prod
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/key-rot-2026 --member serviceAccount:gateway@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
arjun: also adding a quick unit check to release pipeline: `python -m infra.kms_check --key $KMS_KEY_ID --sa gateway@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
julia: tagging customer success to notify affected tenant and share timeline
samir: will follow up on why IAM binding was omitted in rotation steps. likely human step missed in rotation runbook
ops-oncall: next steps posted to #incidents-docs and assigning postmortem owner arjun. closing this Slack thread for active mitigation, will keep it updated for follow-ups.
maya: thanks team. :thumbsup:
